为什么"公平贸易"标签背后也有环境含义？

Why does a "fair trade" label also carry environmental meaning?

公平贸易常要求少用有毒农药、保护水源与林地，并把更高收购价反哺小农；它把"对人公平"和"对土地友好"绑在了一起。
Fair trade often demands fewer toxic pesticides and protects water and forest while paying small farmers more; it ties "fair to people" with "kind to land".

像《蒙特利尔》《巴黎》这样的全球环境协议，怎么落到本地？

How do global pacts like Montreal or Paris reach the local level?

国际协议先定目标，再靠各国立法、地方限排、企业转型和民众行动层层分解；全球承诺最终变成你身边的制冷剂标准与电动车补贴。
Treaties set goals, then national laws, local caps, corporate shifts and public action break them down; global promises become your local refrigerant standards and EV subsidies.

北极变暖，为什么会让低纬度的天气更"疯"？

Why does Arctic warming make low-latitude weather "wilder"?

北极升温快于全球，削弱了极地与热带的温差，使急流变慢、更易打弯，于是寒潮、热浪更容易"卡"在某个地方不走。
The Arctic warms faster than the globe, weakening the pole-tropics temperature gap so the jet stream slows and meanders, letting cold snaps and heat waves get "stuck" in place.

你餐桌上的进口海鲜，为什么可能牵动半个地球的渔场？

Why might imported seafood on your table tug at fishing grounds halfway around the world?

全球渔业互相连通：某地过度捕捞会推高对其他海域的需求，远洋船队也常跨洋作业；你的一盘鱼，背后是一张全球捕捞网。
Fisheries are linked: overfishing one place raises demand elsewhere, and fleets often fish across oceans; your plate of fish sits on a global catch web.

为什么远方的极端天气，可能和你我有关？

Why might extreme weather far away be linked to you and me?

全球变暖由全人类排放叠加而成，某地干旱洪水是整体气候失衡的局部表现；我们的用电、吃穿都在为这张"全球气候网"添线。
Global warming sums everyone's emissions, and a distant drought or flood is a local face of that imbalance; our power, food and clothes all add threads to the global climate web.

你脚下的一点碳排放，为什么会"飞"到地球另一端？

Why can a bit of carbon you emit "fly" to the other side of the Earth?

大气是连通的，CO₂ 混匀只需约一年就散布全球；本地排的碳很快加入全球"公共空气"，远方的高温或海平面都和它有关。
The atmosphere is connected—CO₂ mixes globally in about a year, so local emissions join the shared air almost at once, linking to distant heat and sea level.
